```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dygraphs)
library(janitor)
library(timetk)
```

```{r}
euro <- read_csv("dane/euro.csv") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(euro = kurs_sredni) %>% 
  select(data, euro)

euro
```

```{r}
dolar <- read_csv("dane/dolar.csv") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(dolar = kurs_sredni) %>% 
  select(data, dolar)

dolar
```

```{r}
waluty <- euro %>% left_join(dolar)
```

```{r}
lungDeaths <- cbind(mdeaths, fdeaths)
dygraph(lungDeaths)
```

```{r}
waluty_xts <- tk_xts(waluty, date_var = data, select = euro:dolar)
```

```{r}
dygraph(waluty_xts) %>% 
  dyRangeSelector()
```

```{r}
dygraph(waluty_xts) %>% 
  dySeries("euro", label = "Euro", color = "blue") %>% 
  dySeries("dolar", label = "Dolar", color = "green") %>% 
  dyOptions(fillGraph = TRUE) %>% 
  dyRangeSelector(height = 20)
```
